sources.title: Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B official model card
sources.evidence: Exact base checkpoint: pretraining-stage causal LM; 0.49B total and 0.36B non-embedding parameters; Transformer architecture; 32,768-token context. The card recommends post-training or fill-in-the-middle use rather than conversation.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen2ForCausalLM, qwen2 model type, 24 layers, hidden size 896, intermediate size 4864, 14 query and 2 KV heads, tied word embeddings, max_position_embeddings 32768. Dense Qwen2 configuration with no expert routing or multimodal components.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-Coder Series: Powerful, Diverse, Practical.
sources.evidence: Dated November 12, 2024; announces 0.5B among four newly released sizes and states both Base and Instruct checkpoints were released. The 0.5B row reports 0.49B total, 0.36B non-embedding, 32K context, and Apache 2.0.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-Coder Technical Report, revision 3
sources.evidence: Attributes the six-size Qwen2.5-Coder series to Alibaba Group, describes architecture inherited from Qwen2.5, separates base-model and instruction-model evaluations, and describes text/code pretraining and fill-in-the-middle completion.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B tokenizer configuration
sources.evidence: Direct HTTPS retrieval succeeded after the web reader could not access the raw endpoint. Qwen2Tokenizer, model_max_length 32768, and a chat template that serializes tool definitions, tool calls and responses. This template is not evidence of validated tool-calling ability in the base weights.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B released files
sources.evidence: Public repository contains model.safetensors, LICENSE, configuration and tokenizer files for the exact unsuffixed base model.

sources.title: Hugging Face checkpoint metadata for Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B
sources.evidence: Current revision is 8123ea2e9354afb7ffcc6c8641d1b2f5ecf18301. Safetensors metadata reports 494,032,768 BF16 parameters, consistent with the developer-rounded 0.49B. Repository creation on November 8 is not the public announcement date.

sources.title: Models.dev Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B record
sources.evidence: Baseline catalog lead points to the exact base repository and asserts reasoning=false and tools=false; those booleans are not independently established by the primary materials reviewed.

name.note: Exact unsuffixed repository name; not Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B-Instruct.

developer.note: Technical report identifies Qwen Team, Alibaba Group.

family.note: Qwen2.5-Coder is a code-specialized member of the Qwen family.

release_date.note: Official announcement explicitly introduces the 0.5B size on this date. Earlier repository creation does not establish public release.

open_weights.note: The exact base checkpoint is publicly downloadable as model.safetensors.

license.note: Official launch table assigns Apache 2.0 to 0.5B; repository includes LICENSE.

parameters_b.note: Developer-rounded total in billions; current checkpoint metadata counts 494,032,768 parameters (0.494032768B). The model-name 0.5B is nominal.

active_parameters_b.note: Dense model without routed experts; no separate active-per-token count is defined. The published 0.36B is non-embedding parameters, not active parameters.

architecture.note: Dense decoder-only Qwen2 Transformer: Qwen2ForCausalLM configuration, grouped-query attention and ordinary feed-forward layers; no mixture-of-experts configuration.

context_window.note: Exact limit agrees across model card, position embeddings and tokenizer.

modalities.note: Text/code token input and autoregressive text output; no image, audio or video model components.

reasoning.note: Code-reasoning evaluations do not establish a dedicated reasoning mode. Exact-base primary documentation does not independently substantiate the catalog boolean false.

tool_call.note: Tokenizer supports tool-message formatting, but the model card identifies pretrained base weights and discourages conversational use. Neither native tool-call ability nor its categorical absence is verified.

description.value: Qwen2.5-Coder base language model for code generation and fill-in-the-middle completion, released with open weights under Apache 2.0.
description.note: Replaces unsupported on-device suitability and subjective tiny/lightweight language with the documented base-model identity and completion purpose.

patch.description: Qwen2.5-Coder base language model for code generation and fill-in-the-middle completion, released with open weights under Apache 2.0.
patch.notes: This is the pretrained base checkpoint, not the Instruct variant. Developer-rounded total is 0.49B; current Safetensors metadata counts 494,032,768 parameters. The 0.36B non-embedding figure is not an active-parameter count. Dense active parameters are not separately defined. Tool-formatting support in the tokenizer does not establish tool-calling competence of the base weights; dedicated reasoning-mode support also remains unverified.

sources.label: Hugging Face checkpoint metadata for Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B

summary: Audited all 14 fields against the exact base checkpoint. Correct total parameters from nominal 0.5B to developer-rounded 0.49B and identify dense architecture. Confirm November 12 release, Apache 2.0, open weights and 32,768-token context. Keep active parameters null and replace unsupported description. Reasoning-mode and native tool-calling status remain unverified; tokenizer tool syntax alone is insufficient.
